subject.title: WhatsApp QR-unavailable/headless login needs phone-code fallback

question: Should WhatsApp phone-code login be exposed through the generic `ChannelAuthAdapter` login-method contract and `channels login --phone-number`, or should the entrypoint stay WhatsApp-owned?
rationale: The remaining work is not only a WhatsApp implementation detail: the active PRs add public CLI and plugin-facing auth surface while changing persisted WhatsApp credential classification.

options.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Fix
options.body: Keep the typed generic login-method/phone-number path, but require the Baileys pairing-code fix, QR compatibility, and live/upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Move To WhatsApp-Owned Surface
options.body: Rework the fallback so phone-code login stays local to the WhatsApp plugin without expanding the generic channel-auth contract.

options.title: Pause Until Dependency Proof Is Stronger
options.body: Keep the issue open but wait for stronger Baileys pairing-code hardening or live proof before committing to a public entrypoint.

recommendation.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the typed generic login-method/phone-number path, but require the Baileys pairing-code fix, QR compatibility, and live/upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses public CLI, plugin SDK/channel-auth, docs, and WhatsApp login behavior, and current history points to steipete across those seams.
